taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Azure Functions host/function keys and application action authority
controls.source_trace: Identify what the key actually admits and whether a caller with an intended narrow key reaches another function or protected business operation.
controls.implementation_branch: Identify function, host and administrative/master key scope without copying key material into reports. A function key may intentionally authenticate a shared integration; it does not identify an end user. Compare invocation admission with handler authorization, and account for an explicitly anonymous trigger or an alternate authenticated gateway before classifying key reachability.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an owned function fixture with synthetic effects; compare an intended function key and a restricted function/action.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A publishable endpoint or a key parameter is not account administration authority; a handler can still enforce its own actor policy.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Restrict key distribution/scope and handler permissions, then verify intended trigger calls and cross-function denial.
